model_config.sampler: Explicit bilinear gathers with border clamping
model_config.support_extent: Predicted foreground >0.5; full support if empty; minimum4featurecells

curriculum_config.identity: Typed planar construction graph and part parameters
curriculum_config.positive: Independent geometry, material, lighting and background draws
curriculum_config.negative: One edge addition/deletion or one local micro-hole pattern change, under matched rendering
curriculum_config.split: Disjoint program seed namespaces, no natural category names

training_objective_config.quality_target: IoU if target present and IoU>=0.5, otherwise0
training_objective_config.point_target: Gaussian distribution around visible canonical counterpart, otherwise dustbin
training_objective_config.correspondence_scene_filter: Positive scenes only; global type absence never labels all shared local parts unmatched
training_objective_config.correspondence_negative_filter: Exclude256-grid sites within2pixels of non-target objects; canonical sites plus target/background grid remain
training_objective_config.foreground_use: Auxiliary predicted weighting only; no ground-truth mask in model forward

proposal_config.selection: All deduplicated generic anchors and bounded edge boxes; no learned filtering

config.checkpoint_rule: Random initialization and final planned update only; no DEV/TEST checkpoint selection

config.sampler: Explicit bilinear gathers with border clamping
config.support_extent: Predicted foreground >0.5; full support if empty; minimum4featurecells

ledger_encoding: Raw RGB SHA256 hashes bytes only. Tensor hashes and stream entries include dtype+shape+bytes. Program IDs parse32bytes from hex.
supervision: RGB enters the model; synthetic masks/correspondence/ROI-quality targets supervise losses. No natural photos or external pretrained weights.
history_policy: Immutable atomic64-step history/ledger shards after successful optimizer updates; final history.jsonl assembled atomically.
